name: readable-catalog-contracts
goal: Every function and visual component has a reviewed plain-language contract explaining accepted inputs, returned behavior, and declared failures without requiring source.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: All active functions and components must have declared responsibilities and per-field explanations. Exact names, types, error sets and runtime behavior stay unchanged.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: The catalog guard fails on 4,133 missing responsibility, review-origin or field-description entries across active functions and components. Log: /tmp/harness-readable-contracts-red-20261017.log.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Reviewed and applied 607 function, component and shell contracts against owned source, tests and dependency contracts. Every active function/component now declares its purpose and field descriptions; corrected six derived UI input lists.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged catalog guard passes across all 623 active functions and components. The 13 verification wrapper and root observation checks also pass. Log: /tmp/harness-readable-contracts-green-20261017.log.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
